name: spinner
description: A turning ring in a hue, the size of the text, for waiting with no known end; a busy button shows the same ring after its label.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the bright edge.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The ring is one em of the size's text step.

a11y.notes: Standing alone, give it role="status" and an aria-label such as "Loading", so the wait is announced once. Inside a button that carries aria-busy="true" it needs nothing: the button already says it is busy, and the ring appears by itself. Under reduced motion the ring stands still.
